claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT) on both nights.
A pre-show for WrestleMania 42 begins at 3 p.m. ET (12 p.m. PT) on both days.
WrestleMania 42 is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 streams on ESPN Unlimited in the US.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 11 p.m. BST in the UK.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 5 p.m. CT in Mexico.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 3:30 a.m. IST (following day) in India.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 9 a.m. AEDT (following day) in Australia.
